name: goja-host-configurable-array-sort-work-budgets
instr:
goja cannot currently limit or report the work performed by JavaScript array sorting. Add deterministic, runtime-configurable budgets, including for re-entrant sorts. The same Runtime created by `goja.New` must enable, replace, inspect, or disable them and expose each completed sort's outcome.

Give every sort an independent allowance. Charge comparisons once per element comparison. Report reads and successful representation-specific mutations from the property, storage, handler, movement, cache, accessor, and missing-property operations actually performed. Authorize charges before effects, so denied work neither occurs nor enters completed totals.

Exhaustion must produce `SortBudgetError`, identify the denied `SortWorkKind`, preserve completed accounting in its `SortReport`, and publish it through `Runtime.LastSortReport`. Every sort, including one started recursively by a comparator on a Runtime obtained with `goja.New`, gets a separate allowance and leaves an independently identifiable completed report through `Runtime.LastSortReport`. The outermost report remains selected when its comparator catches inner exhaustion. Forwarding receivers charge each underlying effect once while preserving key tracking, identity, and observations.

Apply this uniformly to dense and sparse native arrays, generic array-like objects, Go slices, reflected Go arrays and slices, dynamic arrays, and typed-array `sort` and `toSorted`. Preserve holes, undefined, accessors, numeric ordering, copyin
